topics: Limitation of conventional solid state devices at Microwave.
Structure, Operation, Power output and efficiency of IMPATT and TRAPATT diodes
Microwave amplifiers and oscillators – Amplifiers – Gain and stability
Oscillator design – One port negative resistance oscillators.
Microwave Network Analysis – Equivalent voltages and currents
Impedance matching and tuning – Matching with lumped elements
Microwave filters – Periodic structures – Analysis of infinite periodic structures and terminated periodic structures
Filter design by image parameter method – Constant k, m-derived and composite.
Filter design by insertion loss method.
Introduction to MICSs:-Technology of hybrid MICs, monolithic MICs.
Planar transmission lines such as strip line, microstripline, and slot line.
Distributed and lumped elements of integrated circuits -capacitors, inductors, resistors, terminations, attenuators, resonators and discontinuities.

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: 2 questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.  Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.  Each question carries 9 marks.

courseOutcomes.description: Describe the basic principles of Microwave solid state diodes, transistors, generators and amplifiers.
Analyse Microwave Networks  using  signal flow graphs
Design microwave filters by different methods
Illustrate the basic concepts of Monolithic Integrated Circuits
